changes.old: A six-digit system number used by Visa to identify the processing centers and clients. CIBs are assigned to processing centers operated by clients, nonclient processing centers designated by clients, and the clients that operate processing centers. Note: The BASE II CIB of a given processing center does not necessarily appear in the cardholder account numbers processed by that center.
changes.new: A six-digit system number used by Visa to identify the processing centers and clients. Center Identification Blocks (CIBs) are assigned to processing centers operated by clients, nonclient processing centers designated by clients, and the clients that operate processing centers. Note: The BASE II CIB of a given processing center does not necessarily appear in the cardholder account numbers processed by that center.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo pero se añadió el término 'Center Identification Blocks (CIBs)' para clarificar el concepto sin alterar el significado o reglas de negocio.
